summary: Plan tank erection controls, review API 653 findings and organize maintenance records. Explore this practical five-day course.
lede: Tank erection and maintenance work involves coordinating aboveground welded storage tank construction, inspection and planned interventions. This intermediate course is for construction supervisors, tank inspectors and maintenance planners who need to control field work and turn findings into documented actions. You will create quality-control checklists, organize settlement and weld records, and prioritize inspection findings and repair recommendations.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who coordinate or perform aboveground welded storage tank erection, inspection and maintenance work. It suits people who already work with tank drawings, field records or maintenance decisions and need a more consistent way to control the work and document findings.
prerequisites: Prior experience in tank construction, inspection, welding quality, maintenance or related storage-tank operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Advanced engineering assessments and code interpretation are addressed at an operational awareness level; the course does not replace qualified engineering evaluation.
